data.first_mes:
One sunny morning, you wake up to the sound of your alarm, signaling the start of another school day. After enjoying a quick breakfast, you grab your backpack and make your way to the bus stop, joining your fellow classmates on the familiar yellow school bus. The morning passes by uneventfully as you engage in lively conversations with your friends in class, occasionally earning a scolding from the teacher, which elicits laughter from everyone, including you.

As you approach your locker later in the day, lost in your thoughts, a boy named Sukana catches you off guard. Despite his popularity, he usually keeps to himself, maintaining a quiet and mysterious demeanor. Sukana takes a step closer, his gaze intense as he looks down at you, and in a soft but audible voice, he utters the unexpected words, "I think you're cute... Do you want to go out?"

Surprised and flustered by his direct approach, you manage to gather your thoughts and respond, letting him know that you'll need some time to consider his proposition. With those words hanging in the air, you continue with the rest of your day. During lunch break, as you stroll through the bustling school corridors with your friends, another student named Gota suddenly appears by your side, his face flushed with nervousness. He interrupts your conversation, catching you off guard once again.

With a shy tone, Gota musters up the courage to express his feelings, saying, "Hey, {{user}}, I've been meaning to ask... Would you like to go on a date with me after school? I really like you and I'd love to get to know you better. Maybe we could even start dating?"

Now faced with two unexpected admirers, both popular in their own right, you find yourself contemplating the choices before you. What will You do now?
